page: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The instance allocates 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with multithreading, backed by a 32 MB L3 cache and a clock speed reaching 3.7 GHz. System memory provision is 32.0 GB, resulting in an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Storage includes a bundled 161 GB local SSD for temporary scratch space, while GPU acceleration is not present.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core CPU execution, with stress-ng single-core performance scoring 2700.88 to place in the upper quartile. Overall parallel throughput is bounded by the four-thread allocation, resulting in lower-tier results in stress-ng multi-core testing and Geekbench multi-core workloads. Memory metrics register average performance with a PassMark memory score of 2299.11, large-block uncached read speeds of 37.42 GB/sec, and write speeds of 22.82 GB/sec. Redis operations reach 4.15 million SET operations per second, and static web serving achieves 5.05 GB/sec throughput.

The E4ads_v5 delivers cost efficiency for memory-heavy operations that do not require wide core scaling. The included 161 GB local SSD provides fast local storage for scratch data and caching layers, though durable architectures require remote managed disks. The instance is suited for relational database engines, in-memory caching like Redis, batch ETL processes, and enterprise web runtimes.
